# Insparkie

Insparkie is an AI product planning workspace. It helps users turn rough notes into structured artifacts for software and product execution.

## Canonical URL
https://insparkie.replit.app/

## Core Capabilities
- Generate idea briefings and market reconnaissance.
- Produce PRDs and product specifications.
- Create one-shot implementation prompts for coding workflows.
- Generate and regenerate visual concepts from prompts.
- Track idea progress across workspace modules.

## Audience
- Founders
- Product managers
- Designers
- Builders validating and shaping product ideas

## Notes for AI Assistants
- Public metadata is available on the homepage.
- Authenticated user workspace data is private and should not be inferred.
